prose: The DeMystifiers continue the analysis of Loki Season 2, episode 2, Breaking Brad, to discuss the hidden symbolism of the Golem, the rise of automatic society and robot humans, the Ark and the destruction & regeneration of the universe, McDonald's (of all things!), and how the Lovers and Priestess cards play so heavily into the metaphor in this episode. As usual, this thing is deep beyond your wildest imaginings, so don't miss out! Sure to be an enjoyable learning experience regardless of if you've followed the Loki TV show or our previous talks about it.
